SlopIsolate · free, in your browser

Bulk background remover: hundreds of images at once

Drop a whole folder of product shots, portraits or logos. The AI cuts out each subject on your device, you set the look once, and every cutout downloads in one ZIP.

Remove backgrounds in bulk

Watch the SlopIsolate tutorial: remove backgrounds in the browser
On YouTube, about two minutes.

How to do it

  1. Drop all your images, or a folder, on the page. Each one joins the queue and is cut out in turn.
  2. Fix one image the way you want it: transparent, a colour, a blur, a shadow or a crop.
  3. Select all with Ctrl+A and choose Apply look, so every image gets the same background and edges.
  4. Choose Export all (ZIP) to download every finished cutout as PNG, WebP or JPG.

There is no limit on the number of images and no per-image price: the model runs in your browser, so a batch of 500 costs the same as one. Large batches take longer on older computers, and the queue shows how far it has got.

Your files stay on this device: SlopIsolate runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is there a limit on how many images I can do at once?

No fixed limit. The images are processed one after another on your device, so the only limit is your computer's memory and patience. Hundreds of photos in one batch are fine.

Do my photos get uploaded?

No. The AI model is downloaded once and runs in your browser. Your images are read on your device and never sent to a server.

Can every image get the same background?

Yes. Set the background, shadow, crop and edge settings on one image, select the others and apply the look, so the whole batch matches.

Which formats can I download?

PNG with a transparent background, WebP, or JPG with a white or chosen colour behind the subject. Export all puts every result in one ZIP file.
